description: Artur Trindade contributed electricity-load diagrams for 370 clients to the UCI Machine Learning Repository. The 2011–2014 time series records power in kilowatts every fifteen minutes, with one client per column and Portuguese local timestamps. Semicolon-delimited text is available from the repository, free under CC BY 4.0. The provider reports no missing values but fills periods before clients became active with zeros. Every day has 96 intervals: spring clock changes introduce zeros, while autumn clock changes combine two hours. These conventions require care when modelling demand or comparing energy totals. PADELF lists the resource for electricity-load forecasting. BuildingsBench is a related benchmark that incorporates the UCI load diagrams. The source does not locate individual clients; Portuguese timestamps alone do not establish their country. This record describes the published metadata; file contents were not downloaded or tested.
